skus.name: WAIMD — Work Assignment. Instant Move Decision.
skus.domain: Travel-nurse housing decisions (a confirmed assignment → 3 evidence-backed housing choices)
skus.icp: A U.S. travel nurse who has ACCEPTED a temporary hospital assignment, starts within 30 days, and has not secured housing (PRD §1). Qualification is a hard gate — 'not yet accepted' is a dead end by design: no newsletter funnel, no generic leads, no contamination of the experiment (§7).
skus.constitution: WAIMD transforms a travel nurse's accepted assignment into three evidence-backed housing choices. Nothing else until strangers pay for that outcome.
skus.repo_note: D32 — the code lives in Radix-Obsidian/StayEz; the PRODUCT is still WAIMD on waimd.org (founder decision 2026-07-31: repo name only, not a rebrand). The SKU slug stays waimd-housing because that is the product's identity in this registry. Override the checkout path with WAIMD_HOUSING_PATH when the clone is not a sibling of factory-core.

billing.model: freemium preview → $29 one-time unlock (PRD §15): free = Housing Mission + Match #1 preview; $29 unlocks the full 3-choice Decision (evidence, sources, total cost, comparisons, fees, risk flags, recommendation, next action)
billing.note: No subscription, no commissions, no landlord advertising, NO payment before value. If WAIMD cannot produce three qualifying options the customer pays $0. TEST mode until the D5 publish+charge gate — flip test→live only with PUBLISH_APPROVAL_TOKEN.
billing.provider_note: D27 — Polar, NOT Stripe. The PRD (§15/§26) names Stripe Checkout; the founder overrode it after Stripe was compromised and declined to remediate. Polar is the payment gateway for this SKU and the portfolio going forward. ops/revenue.mjs is a Stripe-only reader and reports n/a for polar rather than sending a Polar credential to api.stripe.com.

fulfillment.note: PRD §18 — a FEATURE, not a stopgap. For the first 10–50 missions software handles qualification/schema/requirements/filtering/scoring/presentation/payments/analytics; the founder handles difficult discovery, unclear availability, manual verification, and edge cases. Every intervention is labeled data (manual_reason enum) that becomes the automation backlog. Don't automate guesses — automate observed work.

supply.inventory_owned: none ($0 — the scarce asset is converting fragmented inventory into a decision, not the inventory itself)
supply.constraint: PRD §17 — do NOT scrape sources whose terms prohibit it. V0 combines public/authorized information with founder-assisted verification; licensed feeds/APIs/partnerships only later.

metrics.note: PRD §23. CAC = ad spend / completed qualified missions. Solvability = can we produce three qualifying options. Paid rate = purchases / completed solvable missions.

kill_criteria.kill_acquisition: $70 spent AND <5 qualified missions → do not spend another $70 automatically
kill_criteria.kill_proposition: 10 successfully fulfilled missions AND 0 purchases → do not build more features
kill_criteria.investigate: 10 fulfilled AND 1–2 purchases → signal but not enough; interview behavior and change ONE variable
kill_criteria.continue: 10 fulfilled AND ≥3 purchases → earned another iteration
kill_criteria.note: PRD §24 — executable via ops/waimd-gate.mjs so the finish condition actually fires (D24 lesson: prose gates never did).

analytics.note: PRD §22/§26 — simple event store; instrument only what affects the hypothesis.

data_layer.note: D27 founder override of PRD §26 (Supabase free tier from day one): Prisma ORM for this stage, then scale into Supabase Postgres — a datasource swap, not a rewrite. Confirmed by the founder 2026-07-31. The decision engine is persistence-free, so the data layer never touches it.

engine.note: Deterministic decision engine (PRD §10 five gates, §13 100-pt score, §14 max-3, §11 evidence ladder). Pure, zero-dependency, no I/O, no LLM, never reads the clock (asOf is always explicit). Proven in the factory BEFORE the beta exists, and ports verbatim into the product repo.

readiness_gate.note: D27 — the founder withholds the $70 Meta authorization until the beta is built and tested. This gate scores that condition mechanically and exits non-zero while NOT READY; it cannot go green while the product repo or the beta is absent.

skus.critical_path_llm: none — PRD §26 pins a deterministic first decision engine and no paid LLM on the critical path. D22 caching-check PASSES at zero call sites; never add an LLM to the critical path to satisfy a checker.

gtm.note: NOT gtm/waimd — that is the FROZEN FMCSA cold-email engine (D24). This product is Meta-ads acquisition; its own engine dir is gtm/waimd-housing.
